= -500,000.00 + 360,000.00 + 0.00
= -140,000.00

Formula: EV_stop = Sale_value

EV_continue = -500,000.00 + 360,000.00 = -140,000.00

Since 60,000.00 > -140,000.00, stop maximizes expected value from today.
